{
  "dataset_name": "blood_transfusion",
  "model_family": "tree",
  "schema_generator": "gemini-3-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "active_tenure_months",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The number of months between the donor's first and last donation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 98.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_difference",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a direct measure of the donor's active lifespan, allowing tree models to split on donor longevity independent of absolute dates.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V4 - V1"
    },
    {
      "name": "donations_per_month_tenure",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The average number of donations per month over the donor's entire tenure.",
      "value_range": [0.01, 25.0],
      "feature_family": "rate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes donation frequency by tenure, creating a continuous rate that helps trees identify consistently highly engaged donors.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V2 / V4"
    },
    {
      "name": "recent_donor_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for donors who have donated within the last 6 months.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "boolean_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Creates a hard boolean split for recent activity, which is a strong predictor in RFM models, saving the tree from learning this threshold.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V1 <= 6, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "frequent_donor_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator for donors who have made 5 or more donations.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "boolean_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Isolates donors with a proven track record of multiple donations, providing a clear categorical split for tree ensembles.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V2 >= 5, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donations_per_active_month",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The rate of donations calculated only over the months the donor was actively donating.",
      "value_range": [0.01, 50.0],
      "feature_family": "rate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Measures donation density during the period the donor was actually active, offering a refined engagement metric robust to long periods of recent inactivity.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V2 / np.maximum(V4 - V1, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "single_donation_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Boolean indicator flagging donors who have only donated exactly once.",
      "value_range": [0, 1],
      "feature_family": "boolean_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Explicitly flags one-time donors, allowing trees to easily separate them from repeat donors who exhibit different behavioral patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V2 == 1, 1, 0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_frequency_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The product of recency and frequency, highlighting historically frequent donors who have not donated recently.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3700.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the non-linear relationship between recency and frequency; high values highlight historically frequent donors who are currently lapsing.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 * V2"
    },
    {
      "name": "recency_to_tenure_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The ratio of months since last donation to months since first donation.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Expresses recency as a fraction of total tenure, helping trees identify donors who churned early versus those who remained active for most of their tenure.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "V1 / V4"
    },
    {
      "name": "expected_donations_shortfall",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The estimated number of missed donations, assuming a standard eligibility cycle of one donation every 3 months.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 32.0],
      "feature_family": "deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Quantifies missed donations assuming a standard 3-month eligibility cycle, providing a continuous measure of lapsing behavior.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.maximum(0.0, (V4 / 3.0) - V2)"
    },
    {
      "name": "donor_loyalty_index",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of donor loyalty based on frequency, recency, and time, categorizing into ordinal levels of commitment.",
      "value_range": [1, 5],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_bucket",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic, ordinal categorization of donor commitment, allowing trees to split on high-level semantic groupings rather than raw RFM values.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "attrition_risk_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic evaluation of the likelihood that the donor has permanently stopped donating, comparing their recency to their average donation interval.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "risk_assessment",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Synthesizes recency and historical frequency into a single risk probability, giving trees a direct feature to assess the likelihood of permanent dropout.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "average_months_between_donations",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "The average number of months that elapsed between consecutive donations for repeat donors.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 98.0],
      "feature_family": "temporal_rate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Calculates the historical interval between donations, enabling trees to identify donors with regular, predictable patterns versus sporadic ones.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(V2 > 1, (V4 - V1) / np.maximum(V2 - 1, 1), V4)"
    }
  ]
}
